name: vacuum_multixact_freeze_table_age
description: Multixact age threshold at which VACUUM scans the entire table to freeze multixact IDs and prevent wraparound.
symptoms: unexpected full-table VACUUMs causing I/O spikes
replication lag due to long-running vacuum operations
tuning_tips: Set lower than autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age (typically 95% of it) to trigger proactive freezing before wraparound risk; reduce further for tables with high multixact churn, but avoid excessive full-table scans.
